blocks.text: Kisi cheez ke molecules ki har qisam ki energy (kinetic aur potential) ka jor (sum) us ki internal energy kehlata hai. Thermodynamics mein aam taur par ideal gas ko working substance (jis par kaam ho raha ho) liya jata hai. Ideal gas ke molecules sirf mass wale points hain jo ek doosre par koi force nahi lagate, is liye un ki potential energy nahi hoti. Is liye ideal gas ki internal energy aam taur par us ke molecules ki translational K.E. (seedhi motion ki kinetic energy) hoti hai. Temperature molecules ki average (darmiyani value) K.E. ka naap hai, is liye ideal gas ki internal energy us ke temperature ke directly proportional (ek barhe to doosra bhi usi hisab se barhe) hai.
Kinetic theory of gases ke mutabiq gas ke molecules ki average kinetic energy yeh hai:

Is liye kisi cheez ka temperature barhne ka matlab hai ke us ke particles ki andar wali kinetic energy barh gayi. Internal energy ka yeh increase (barhna) heat absorb (andar le lena) karne se ho sakta hai: heat particles ki average kinetic energy barhati hai aur is se cheez ka temperature barh jata hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Diatomic (do atoms wale) gas molecule mein translational aur rotational (ghoomne ki) energy dono hoti hain. Atoms ke darmiyan spring jaise bond ki wajah se is mein vibrational (larazne ki) energy bhi hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Do neeli gendein (atoms) ek kundal-daar spring se juri hui, tirchhi rakhi hui. Spring par Vibration likha hai. Molecule ke gird do curved (mura hua) teer, oopar daen wale par Rotation likha hai, use ghoomta dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Do You Know? (PDF page 124): Diatomic gas molecule mein translational aur rotational energy hoti hai; atoms ke darmiyan spring jaise bond ki wajah se vibrational energy bhi (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Diatomic molecule teen tarah move karta hai: poora molecule ek jagah se doosri jagah jata hai (translation), apne beech ke gird ghoomta hai (rotation, mude hue teer), aur dono atoms spring jaise bond par aage peeche larazte hain (vibration). Har motion (chalna ya hilna) ki apni energy hai aur sab internal energy mein shamil hain.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Kai processes internal energy aur temperature badal sakte hain: heating (heat dena), adiabatic compression ya expansion (heat ka koi len den nahi), ya phase change (jahan heat cheez ki halat badalti hai magar temperature nahi badalta, jaise barf ka pighalna).

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Internal energy state ka function (state function) hai: yeh is par depend nahi karti ke system kis raste se guzra, sirf shuru aur aakhri halat par depend karti hai. Is lehaz se yeh gravitational P.E. jaisi hai. Potential energy ki tarah internal energy mein bhi us ki change (ΔU) aham hai, us ki poori (absolute) value nahi.

blocks.prompt: Internal energy kya hai, aur ideal gas mein yeh temperature se kaise judi hai?
blocks.explanation: Internal energy kisi cheez ke saare molecules ki kul kinetic aur potential energy hai. Ideal gas ke molecules ek doosre par force nahi lagate, is liye un ki potential energy nahi; U sirf translational kinetic energy hai, jo har molecule ke liye average mein (3/2) k_B T hai. Is liye U absolute temperature ke directly proportional hai: temperature barhe to internal energy barhti hai.

items: Internal energy = molecules ki saari K.E. + P.E.; ideal gas mein sirf translational K.E., <½mv²> = (3/2) k_B T, is liye U ∝ T.
Internal energy state function hai: sirf ΔU aham hai. Heating, adiabatic processes aur phase change ise badalte hain.
